native.scope: Execution only on named runner; Windows Server CI is not physical Windows11 certification; no sleep/wake or native publisher authentication.

localSetup.scope: Actual read-only installed package verifies all added notice resources, serves private local setup HTTP200 and closes listener; no public endpoint or browser/phone test

audit.scope: Actual npm tarball contents and frozen source/native/dependency/notice inventory; integrity is not publisher authentication or legal clearance.

Final authenticated npm target evidence required: win32-x64
Final authenticated npm target evidence required: linux-x64

stages: S06: Build one npm candidate; audit actual tarball and source/native/connector/dependency/notices; freeze exact SHA-256 and npm integrity in this review
S06: Resolve deferred account/publisher/rights inputs; reuse MIT source license; finish notice review
S07-S09: Authenticate four native payload sets and demonstrate macOS notarization delivery, Windows signature/timestamp and persistent inventory signature
S07-S10: Generate resource hashes after signing; pack final npm bytes; repeat tarball and installed clean-target checks; host Node is separate and connector preparation is explicit
S11: Review exact authenticated candidate, deferred target/device/network evidence and pinned publisher setup; local checks require no already-published registry attestation

S12: Recheck name availability/account access; an unpublished name is not reserved and ownership is established on accepted first publication. After separate authorization, publish exact reviewed tarball with approved provenance; verify registry version/integrity/attestations and installation before separately authorized stable promotion
plan.note: No signing, keychain access, credentials, account creation, upload or promotion occurs. Registry provenance is verified after authorized publication, not required to audit a local candidate.
